name: Play this life
summary:
Experience life as a different person, do whatever you want with this new life you’ve been given, live like you’ve never lived before!

This open-ended text-based life simulator packs real-world odds, novel-worthy storylines and an in-game clock together with realistic NPCs who grow and change alongside virtual you.

Be born in a village in an underdeveloped country or be heir to the fortunes of the top 1%! Be cared for by your family, or feel what it’s like to have them absolutely detest you. Make your life story a beautiful romance or dedicate all of your time to growing your career. Live in the home of your dreams or struggle to get out of homelessness. Have children, grandchildren, great grandchildren, or just squander all of your money exploring life’s possibilities!

No fixed storylines. No right or wrong answers. Just life as it is in your wildest dreams—and nightmares. With Play This Life, you now have so much more than just one life to live.
